propositions: The workflow editor must expose a read-only Effective Policy view derived from S1 CriteriaSnapshot while keeping Authored Workflow as the sole editable YAML/BPMN source.
A project code-review LLM criterion with missing, empty, non-list, or blank applies_to globs must be rejected at save validation with a remedy suggesting ["**"] for repository-wide scope.

Effective Policy data must display criterion digest/source, gate, execution tier, posture, applicability, and enabled/disabled provenance without exposing execution trace, debugging detail, or review results.
Snapshot load or validation failure must mark Effective Policy unavailable with a located actionable error and never silently substitute packaged defaults or permit an invalid save.
The serialized authored YAML/BPMN must remain byte-equivalent across policy changes; only the derived read-only view updates.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selector controls, and plan-review authoring fields are exempt from the project-LLM applies_to glob validation rule.
